body:
## Finding

`scripts/validate_records_against_research.py` (#309) compares each ingredient
record against the deep-research report for that same ingredient. Over the 527
records researched so far it found **71 `STATUS_CONFLICT`s** — the record asserts
an ontology mapping while its own report recommended `UNMAPPED`.

**Every one of them was written by the same mechanical sweep,
`promote_resolved_unmapped`.** That is the #203/#263 pattern recurring: a
plausible identifier promoted by a mechanism that never decided anything.

## Important caveat — do not treat all 71 as defects

The Edison/PaperQA3 lane cannot open an ontology page. Its reports say so
verbatim ("no ChEBI CURIE was verified in the retrieved evidence"), so it
defaults to "retain UNMAPPED" whenever it cannot confirm a term — which is most
of the time. An Edison "retain UNMAPPED" on its own is therefore weak evidence.

That is exactly why the second (Claude) lane exists, and it already resolved 22
of these: `LANE_DISAGREEMENT_RESOLVED` marks a conflict the Claude lane cleared
by resolving the term Edison could not. Those 22 need no action.

## Triage order

Work `mappings/record_research_validation.md`, most severe first:

1. **17 `BOTH_LANES_DISPUTE`** — both independent lanes dispute the mapping.
   Strongest signal in the ledger; start here.
2. **`P1 CURIE_REFUTED`** — a report names the record's exact CURIE and argues
   against it. The quoted line usually names the right term.
3. **`P1 VERDICT_REFUTES`** — a per-field verdict table refutes an identity
   field and supplies a corrected value.
4. The remainder of the `STATUS_CONFLICT`s, checking `promoted_by` and
   `documented_rationale`.

Each row carries the quoted report line that produced it, so most are a one-read
decision: keep with a written justification, downgrade `mapping_quality`, or
demote.

## Note on coverage

The ledger currently covers 527 of 2,841 records; the Edison sweep is ongoing
(~30 records/hour, account-capped). Re-run the validator as it completes — these
counts will grow.

Each was judged **as the record stands today**, against `chebi.db`, by an independent reader.

| verdict | n | meaning |
|---|---:|---|
| STALE_DISPUTE | 29 | a later curation event already fixed what the report objected to (event and date cited in each) |
| RECORD_CORRECT | 60 | the report was over-conservative; the mapping holds |
| REGRADE | 10 | right term, quality/predicate wrong |
| REGROUND | 25 | wrong term; a specific CURIE proposed and checked in chebi.db |
| DEMOTE | 1 | no defensible term |

So **89 of 125 need no change** — the reports were written before the June–September re-grounding work and mostly describe a corpus that no longer exists.

Update: the adversarial-verification stage was re-run and failed a second time (usage credits) before any of the 36 proposed changes could be refuted, so their status is unchanged — **proposals, not rulings, none applied**. Full verdicts remain at `~/.claude/mim-triage/triage_results_wf_da9cd12b.json`. The 40 #232 proposals from the same run were verifiable mechanically and are applied in #732; these 36 (25 REGROUND, 10 REGRADE, 1 DEMOTE) are identity decisions and are not.

**Batch 1 landed (#739, main `080d9549`).** Of the 36 unrefuted proposals, the eleven that change no identifier were re-verified against `chebi.db` and applied: five `mapping_quality` regrades (5-Hydroxydodecanoate, Caproic_Acid, Hydroxystreptomycin, D-galactonic_Acid_Lactone, Glutamyl-glutamic_Acid), five `broadMatch` parent re-anchors (1-ethyl-3-methylimidazolium_Acetate, 2-oxobutyric_Acid_Sodium_Salt, both sialyllactose sodium salts, Arabinan_From_Sugar_Beet), and the Mgcl2x_6_H2o tombstone's ontology row. Each went through the review chain as a mapping-change receipt (every touched row withheld, no approval carried): completion SUPPORTED 1763 → 1759.

**Refuted or stale, not applied:**
- `2-dimethylsuccinic_Acid` — already on CHEBI:86537 since 2026-09-22 (stale).
- `05_M_Nitrilotriacetic_Acid_Disodium_Salt`, `Artificial_Sea_Salt` — corrected on 2026-09-21 (stale; the trisodium record `Nitrilotriacetic_Acid_Trisodium_Salt` exists).
- `Arabinoxylan_Rye_Flour` — identity half done 2026-09-21; the parent anchor is correct but blocked by the resolution review's identity-plan pin → #740.
- `Angustmycin` — the bare label is ambiguous between angustmycin A and C; curator call → #741.

**Next batches:** identity swaps (12: 34-Dihydroxyflavone, 4-Hydroxynonenal, Acridine_Orange, Ammonium_Molybdate_Tetrahydrate, Anisodamine_Hydrobromide, Aluminium_Sulfate, Apramycin_Sulfate_Salt, Atrop_Abyssomicin_C, Bisabolene, Bergenin, Catalase, Ferulate), registry mints (6: Algal_Trace_Elements_Solution, B-Glucan_From_Oat, Casamino_Acids_Vitamin_Assay, Cooked_Meat_Medium, Cuso4_X_4_H2o, Cuso4_X_2_H2o), merges (3: 6-deoxy-d-galactose → D-fucose, Cinnamic_Acid → Trans-cinnamic_Acid, Nah2po4h2o → Sodium_phosphate_monobasic_monohydrate).

**Batch 2 landed (#746, main `5e794b94`).** The twelve identity re-groundings, each re-verified against `chebi.db`/`mesh.db`/`ncit.db` and PubChem where the CAS decides the form: 34-Dihydroxyflavone → mesh:C559991, Anisodamine_Hydrobromide → NCIT:C221850 (salt CAS 55449-49-5 recorded; `()` artefact off the label), Apramycin_Sulfate_Salt → CHEBI:190734, 4-Hydroxynonenal → CHEBI:58968, Aluminium_Sulfate → CHEBI:74768, Bisabolene → CHEBI:49240, Acridine_Orange → CHEBI:87346 (free base), Ammonium_Molybdate_Tetrahydrate → CHEBI:86244, Ferulate → CHEBI:29749, Atrop_Abyssomicin_C → CHEBI:208735, Bergenin → cas:108032-11-7 (monohydrate; CHEBI:69499 parent), Catalase → cas:9001-05-2 (mesh:D002374 parent). Two mixtures' components and 46 recipe-membership edges follow the new identifiers. Receipt `issue312-batch2`; completion SUPPORTED 1759 → 1752.

Limitation surfaced: the frozen release-hold resolution binds to SSSOM row positions, so the three now-redundant `kgmicrobe.compound` rows stay and no merge can remove rows → #745.

**Remaining:** registry mints (Algal_Trace_Elements_Solution, B-Glucan_From_Oat, Casamino_Acids_Vitamin_Assay, Cooked_Meat_Medium, Cuso4_X_4_H2o, Cuso4_X_2_H2o) next; merges (6-deoxy-d-galactose, Cinnamic_Acid, Nah2po4h2o) blocked on #745.

**Batch 3 landed (#749, main `5019d687`).** Five registry mints for records narrower than their identifier's term: Algal_Trace_Elements_Solution (MICRO:0000455 class, was shared with WC), B-Glucan_From_Oat (→ parent CHEBI:18504 mixed-linkage glucan), Casamino_Acids_Vitamin_Assay (mesh:C017721 generic), Cuso4_X_4_H2o and Cuso4_X_2_H2o (#344 shape; 10 recipe memberships move off the anhydrous CuSO4 record, 187 → 177). Receipt `issue312-batch3`; completion SUPPORTED 1752 → 1751.

Deferred: Cooked_Meat_Medium → #748 (two mixtures' component references are pinned by the resolution component ledger). Filed from the batch: #751 (WC Trace Elements Solution has the same class-as-identity defect, outside the 36).

**Next:** merges. Cinnamic_Acid → Trans-cinnamic_Acid and Nah2po4h2o → Sodium_phosphate_monobasic_monohydrate sit after the position-bound release hold and can proceed; 6-deoxy-d-galactose → D-fucose (row 286) is blocked by #745.

**Batch 4 landed (#755, main `85dfd987`).** Cinnamic_Acid merged into Trans-cinnamic_Acid (its CAS 140-10-3 is xref'd on the trans term only) and Nah2po4h2o into Sodium_phosphate_monobasic_monohydrate (CHEBI:114249 exists and xrefs cas:10049-21-5); tombstones re-pointed to the survivor's identifier and term, 4 recipe-membership edges added. Receipt `issue312-batch4`.

**Where the 36 proposals stand after four batches** (#739, #746, #749, #755):

| outcome | n | records |
|---|---:|---|
| applied, verified | 30 | 5 regrades, 5 parent re-anchors, 12 identity re-groundings, 5 registry mints, 2 merges, plus the Mgcl2x_6_H2o tombstone (proposal 37) |
| stale before the batch | 3 | 2-dimethylsuccinic_Acid, 05_M_Nitrilotriacetic_Acid_Disodium_Salt, Artificial_Sea_Salt |
| blocked by a review-lock pin | 3 | Arabinoxylan_Rye_Flour parent (#740), Cooked_Meat_Medium mint (#748), 6-deoxy-d-galactose → D-fucose merge (#745) |
| curator call | 1 | Angustmycin (#741) |

Completion review: SUPPORTED 1763 → 1751, WITHHOLD 1255 → 1272 (every touched row withheld pending mapping-specific approval; no approval carried across any receipt). Resolution review: APPROVED 2272 → 2231. Findings: none reopened; 2 on tombstones excluded.

Side findings filed and fixed on the way: #742, #743, #747, #750, #756. Filed and open: #744 (local recipe lacks two CI-only steps), #745, #751 (WC Trace Elements Solution has the class-as-identity defect), #738 (two broadMatch rows whose parent is the exact term).

What remains here is the three lock-blocked items and the Angustmycin call; the mechanism work (#740/#745/#748) is one design change on the resolution side.
